reviews.title: Do NOT Subscribe!
reviews.text:
I liked the videos but quickly found out it is impossible to cancel your subscription once you subscribe.

I even followed their instructions to unsubscribe:
“1. Open Shorts Wave and go to Me.
2. Tap Join Membership at the top of the page.
3. Tap Rules in the top-right corner.
4. Scroll to the bottom of the page and tap Unsubscribe.”

It said I had unsubscribed. I even sent an email asking them to confirm I was unsubscribed.

I never received one response after sending multiple emails after weekly charges kept appearing on my statement. 

It took me having to close my account and disputing the charges with my bank in order to have them reimburse me. I was able to provide proof to my bank by giving them copies of the emails I had sent requesting the cancellations multiple times.

Save yourself the headache and DONT subscribe! You will never hear from them even if you have been emailing them for 2 months!

I have emailed so many times with NO RESPONSE. 
I contacted my bank as well to block and was told the merchant is unblock-able. Apple account doesn’t show any subscriptions either so there’s no where to cancel anything at all. I have already changed my card number and the app is still charging every week. OMG. Please, please cancel and refund immediately. 
I emailed my first cancellation request after 3 days into my first week. So I never approved the 2nd charge and anything onwards.
